facts.title: Watermelon Mint Sorbet
ingredients: 4 pounds of watermelon, seeded and scooped into big chunks
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: Toss watermelon chunks, sugar, lime juice and rum in a blender. Pulverize the watermelon (to pulverize sounds like more fun than to purée, right?).
Add the mint and blend until the mint is chopped into large flecks.
Pour mixture into your ice cream maker and process according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

Transfer to an airtight container and freeze for a few hours, and serve. The sorbet will freeze hard if left in the freezer for more than a few hours. Just set it on the counter for about 20 minutes, or until it is scoopable.

notes: Recipe mildly adapted from Cookin’ Canuck.
facts.summary: Homemade watermelon mint sorbet! Recipe yields about 3 cups.
